Final commit for this project - Exercise  18r - enhancements.  Search function breaks down search string into separate words as an OR function - if either word matches the products are shown.  Also added "Your search did not match any products" message and "Your cart is empty" message and View Products button on cart page.  main branch contained all the edits that were done in the tutorial videos.  18-exercises branch contains all commits done for the lesson 18 exercises.  Merged these into the main branch.  Had one error to correct. In renderOrderSummary() the HTML for each product is stored after '.js-order-summary'.  All 27 test cases are passing.  All program functions are working as they should.
Merge branch '18-exercises'
